# Comment Replies

Draft replies to open comments on a spec, PRD or design doc (Confluence, Notion, Google Docs, or pasted) and to coworker questions, grounded in the document itself, linked decisions and prior threads, and staged for the author's approval: each comment is classified (question, objection, suggestion, decision needed, out of scope), each draft quotes its source, proposes the exact doc edit where the comment is right, and anything only the author can decide — priorities, scope, dates — is held back in a separate list. Nothing is posted or edited before approval.
